papers.title: Mechanical Properties and Microstructural Characterization of Cobalt-Chromium (CoCr) Obtained by Casting and Selective Laser Melting (SLM)
papers.abstract: The aim of this study is the consolidation of Cobalt-Chromium (CoCr) alloy powder using the additive manufacturing - selective laser melting (SLM) and the investment casting techniques. The research of this study has been applied to their biomaterial applied to development of prosthesis and dental implants. The gas atomized powder are spherical (mean diameter equal to 42,74 μm) and was analyzed by their physical and chemical properties. The microstructure of the powder and specimens was evaluated using optical microscope (OM) and scanning electron microscope with energy-dispersed X-ray spectroscopy (SEM-EDS). The mechanical properties were evaluated of standard samples using a tensile (yield strength, maximum tensile, rupture tensile and elongation), three point bending (transverse rupture strength) and micro hardness tests. The mechanical results indicate higher values for the SLM than casting specimens. The micrographs revealed a characteristic morphology of laser been used in the SLM technique and the dendrites in the casting technique. The microstructure of samples made by SLM is thinner than the samples obtained in the cast.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文比较了CoCr合金在SLM和铸造工艺下的力学性能，但未涉及多孔结构、疲劳性能或应力遮挡等与生物力学匹配直接相关的内容。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, fatigue behavior, surface roughness, or osseointegration, which are critical for stress shielding and stiffness matching in biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较SLM与铸造工艺在CoCr合金生物材料中的性能差异
summary_zh.method: 通过拉伸、三点弯曲和显微硬度测试评估SLM和铸造试样的力学性能
summary_zh.result: SLM试样在屈服强度、抗拉强度和硬度方面均高于铸造试样
summary_zh.validation: 使用标准力学测试方法（拉伸、弯曲、硬度）进行验证

summary_en.motivation: This study compares the mechanical properties and microstructure of CoCr alloy fabricated by selective laser melting (SLM) and investment casting for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Standard tensile, three-point bending, and microhardness tests were conducted on both SLM and cast CoCr specimens, with microstructural analysis via OM and SEM-EDS.
summary_en.result: SLM specimens exhibited higher yield strength, ultimate tensile strength, transverse rupture strength, and hardness than cast specimens, with a finer microstructure.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through standardized mechanical testing (tensile, bending, hardness) and microstructural characterization.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文关注全髋关节置换术后随访流程，未涉及股骨柄应力遮挡或微动等生物力学问题。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not quantify stress/strain in the proximal femur, does not compute micromotion, and does not perform any finite element analysis or implant mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少不必要的术后随访，将资源集中于高风险患者。
summary_zh.method: 利用患者自报结果（PROs）筛选需要重点随访的患者。
summary_zh.result: 患者自报结果可有效识别高风险患者，简化随访流程。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床队列数据验证筛选方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce unnecessary follow-up visits after total hip arthroplasty by focusing on high-risk patients.
summary_en.method: Patient-reported outcomes (PROs) are used to stratify patients and identify those requiring intensive monitoring.
summary_en.result: PRO-based stratification effectively identifies high-risk patients and streamlines postoperative follow-up.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated using clinical outcome data from a patient cohort.

papers.title: Valuation of Mechanical Properties and Microstructural Characterization of ASTM F75 Co-Cr Alloy Obtained by Selective Laser Melting (SLM) and Casting Techniques
papers.abstract: Advances in processes using the powder metallurgy techniques are making this technology competitive compared to the other traditional manufacturing processes, especially in medicine area. The additive rapid prototyping technique – selective laser melting (SLM) was applied in a biomaterial of CoCrMoFe alloy (ASTM F75), to study the mechanical properties and microstructural characterization in comparison between the conventional technique – casting. The gas atomized powder was investigated by their physical (as apparent density, bulk density and flow rate) and the chemical properties. The powder was analyzed using scanning electron microscope with energy-dispersed X-ray spectroscopy (SEM-EDS) and X-ray fluorescence. Specimens of standard samples were manufactured using these techniques to evaluate the mechanical properties as uniaxial tensile (yield strength, rupture tensile and elongation), transverse rupture strength and the micro hardness. The mechanical properties showed higher values in the SLM specimens than the casting specimens. Before the mechanical tests the specimens were examined using optical microscope (OM) and SEM-EDS. The micrographs revealed a microstructure with finer morphology in the SLM technique and the dendrites in the casting technique.

summary_en.motivation: To compare the mechanical properties of ASTM F75 Co-Cr alloy fabricated by selective laser melting and conventional casting.
summary_en.method: Standard specimens were manufactured by SLM and casting, followed by uniaxial tensile, transverse rupture strength, and microhardness tests.
summary_en.result: SLM specimens exhibited superior mechanical properties compared to cast specimens.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural characterization was performed using optical microscopy and SEM-EDS.

papers.title: Production and Characterization of Porous Titanium Applied in Biomaterial
papers.abstract: The development of materials with a porous titanium surface has been widely studied in the field of biomaterials due to the excellent biocompatibility, high corrosion resistance and combination of high strength with low density. Another relevant fact is that porosity allows bone tissue growth. However, the high reactivity in liquid state ends up hindering titanium fusion, so an alternative is the powder metallurgy (PM).The aim of this work was to produce porous titanium samples by conventional PM. Porous samples was characterized by porosity and microstructure (optical microscopy - OP and scanning electron microscopy SEM), crystaline phase (X-ray diffraction –XRD), mechanical properties (three point bending test) and cytotoxic test. The results showed the presence of alpha phase, a decrease in the elasticity modulus, increase in average pore size and samples exhibited no toxic effects.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及多孔钛的制备，但使用传统粉末冶金而非增材制造，与AM生物医学方向关联较弱。
llm.why_not_core: This paper uses conventional powder metallurgy instead of additive manufacturing (LPBF/AM), does not include fatigue testing, and does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发多孔钛用于生物材料，克服钛高反应性。
summary_zh.method: 采用传统粉末冶金法制备多孔钛样品。
summary_zh.result: 获得α相多孔钛，弹性模量降低，孔隙增大，无细胞毒性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过三点弯曲测试和细胞毒性实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To produce porous titanium for biomedical applications while addressing the challenge of titanium's high reactivity in the liquid state.
summary_en.method: Porous titanium samples were fabricated using conventional powder metallurgy.
summary_en.result: The resulting porous titanium exhibited alpha phase, reduced elastic modulus, increased average pore size, and no cytotoxic effects.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed via three-point bending tests and in vitro cytotoxicity assays.
